title: Sign in and recovery
data: Identity method and recovery availability
actions: Sign in, enterprise sign in, recover access
interaction: Route to the configured identity provider and return through a verified callback; show safe feedback for unknown identities.
guard: Do not enumerate accounts or bypass federation through recovery.

title: Tenant switch and profile
data: Current membership, tenant names, profile and sessions
actions: Switch tenant, edit permitted profile, end session
interaction: Reload scope and permitted navigation after a switch; clear the previous tenant view and requests.
guard: Do not cache another tenant behind browser Back; identity changes require verification.

title: My work
data: Assigned tasks, due dates, review requests and job outcomes
actions: Open task, filter, acknowledge eligible notice
interaction: Open the exact object and revision context; distinguish overdue work from failed automation.
guard: Only assigned or otherwise permitted work appears; notifications contain safe references.

title: Tenant settings
data: Versioned identity, region, retention and terminology settings
actions: Preview change, save, promote configuration
interaction: Show affected policy and work before applying; conflict on a changed configuration revision.
guard: Prevent removal of final owner and activation without required policy settings.

title: Members and grants
data: Members, role templates, scoped grants, expiry and effective access
actions: Invite, change grant, suspend, revoke, transfer ownership
interaction: Separate membership state from grants; show exact scope and expiry before sensitive commands.
guard: Fresh assurance, issuer bounds and independent custody checks; no browser-assigned issuer.

title: Programme registry
data: Permitted programme registry and lifecycle
actions: Create draft, filter, open, archive
interaction: Preserve filters and cursor context; distinguish no records from no filter matches.
guard: Creation is Draft; activation checks mandatory measurement and policy configuration.

title: Programme workspace
data: Programme overview, activities, risks, obligations and budget links
actions: Edit draft, assign work, activate, archive
interaction: Provide stable navigation between framework, indicators, work, results and reporting.
guard: Material edits retain versions; archive previews unfinished obligations and schedules.

title: Framework editor
data: Versioned nodes, relationships, completeness and comparison
actions: Add node, link, reorder, compare, submit
interaction: Offer graph and accessible tabular editing; validate cycles and missing definitions before review.
guard: Published or reviewed meaning is preserved; a changed graph creates a new candidate.

title: Indicator designer
data: Unit, population, denominator, time meaning, source and targets
actions: Edit, test calculation, compare, submit
interaction: Make aggregation and comparability choices explicit; show sample inputs and expected result.
guard: Block incompatible units, ambiguous denominators and invalid cumulative treatment.

title: Indicator results
data: Periods, values, missingness, approval, coverage and lineage
actions: Inspect contribution, compare periods, request correction
interaction: Show official versus provisional, freshness and excluded contributions beside values.
guard: No averaging displayed percentages; missing, zero and suppressed values remain distinct.

title: Form designer
data: Fields, logic, repeats, language and compatibility
actions: Add field, preview path, test, version, publish
interaction: Validate bounded expressions and dependency cycles; test requiredness and hidden-field handling.
guard: Published instrument immutable; destructive changes require a new version and compatibility handling.

title: Field assignments
data: Minimal assigned tasks, form version and offline lease
actions: Download package, open task, request renewal
interaction: Show last server check, package expiry and on-device availability; keep identities minimal.
guard: Expired or unqualified device cannot unlock restricted content.

title: Collection form
data: Published questions, answers, repeats, media and save status
actions: Save locally, validate, submit
interaction: Label on-device save separately from server receipt; preserve repeat row identity and typed answers.
guard: No false submission success; required media and current assignment checks apply.

title: Sync and conflicts
data: Per-record local state, server receipts, parts and conflicts
actions: Sync, resume, view permitted diff, resolve through correction
interaction: Recover lost acknowledgements by receipt; show each failure without obscuring successful items.
guard: Never overwrite conflicting server revision or expose another author private fields.

title: Import workspace
data: Source digest, locale, mapping, duplicate rules and row outcomes
actions: Upload, preview, map, confirm commit, cancel
interaction: Use a staged flow; bind commit to current preview hash and show atomic versus partial treatment.
guard: Controlled replacement names exact scope; row totals reconcile and cancellation preserves accepted rows.

title: Dataset catalogue
data: Schema, owner, classification, refresh and lineage
actions: Inspect, map, derive, export where permitted
interaction: Show source version, stale data and transformation chain before choosing a dataset.
guard: Exports require separate authority; schema views cannot leak restricted sample rows.

title: Quality queue
data: Issues by severity, rule, affected revision and owner
actions: Correct, revalidate, request exception, review exception
interaction: Keep a correction separate from dismissal; show expiry and scope of approved exceptions.
guard: Blocking issues stop affected approvals or close; exceptions require independent authority.

title: Participant workspace
data: Pseudonym, permitted identifiers, events, relationships and purpose
actions: Record event, update permitted fields, record handling, restrict
interaction: Default to pseudonymous views; disclose direct identifiers only for an authorised purpose.
guard: Keep encrypted identifiers separate; withdrawal does not silently rewrite aggregate arithmetic.

title: Evidence repository
data: Evidence versions, provenance, scan and verification
actions: Upload, inspect, quote, verify, download
interaction: Distinguish transfer, scan, provenance and review states; citations pin exact evidence revision.
guard: Quarantined bytes unavailable; downloads and previews recheck present permission.

title: Evaluation workspace
data: Question, method, source extracts, findings and limitations
actions: Code extract, compare findings, draft recommendation, submit
interaction: Connect each finding to sources and method; preserve disagreement and management responses.
guard: Causal statements require justified method and review; AI suggestions remain labelled drafts.

title: Review queue
data: Exact candidate, changed fields, evidence and independence
actions: Approve, return, reject, delegate within policy
interaction: Pin the candidate and reveal current blockers; require reasons as specified and preserve receipts.
guard: Self-approval and changed-candidate decisions fail at server even when a button was visible.

title: Dashboard editor and viewer
data: Typed widgets, scoped filters, target version and source mode
actions: Filter, drill down, edit layout, save version
interaction: Provide data alternatives to charts; show partial/stale status and official/provisional mode.
guard: Hidden cells and metadata remain absent; filters never expand authority.

title: Report workspace
data: Template, snapshot, narrative, citations and numeric bindings
actions: Draft, reconcile, submit, export, publish, withdraw
interaction: Bind official numbers to result revisions; preview audience and expiry before publication.
guard: Approval, disclosure and publication capability are separate; partial render is never an official download.

title: Period close
data: Expected obligations, blockers, exclusions and snapshot manifest
actions: Refresh readiness, review exclusions, close, restate
interaction: Show the exact version set and outstanding blockers; return a close job and durable outcome.
guard: Late changes invalidate readiness; restatement requires independent approval and a new snapshot.

title: Integration administration
data: Scope, secret reference, qualification, schedule and checkpoints
actions: Test, activate, pause, rotate, run, inspect retry
interaction: Show credential expiry and upstream permission health without reading back secret values.
guard: Service owner and backup are required; retry rechecks destination, credentials and scope.

title: AI workspace
data: Use case, allowed sources, citations, budget and proposals
actions: Ask, inspect evidence, preview diff, confirm draft, cancel
interaction: Display exact sources and target revisions; stale or expired proposals require regeneration.
guard: No autonomous approve, publish, grant or deletion; unsupported consequential claims block use.

title: Privacy and disclosure
data: Cases, verified requester, authority, holds, disclosure and store outcomes
actions: Review, approve plan, execute, verify outcomes, release hold through authority
interaction: Show per-store progress and held actions; distinguish partial completion and effective restriction.
guard: Plan changes invalidate approval; public disclosure checks cumulative inference and download rights.

title: Service operations
data: Service metadata, tenant limits, incidents and support sessions
actions: Inspect health, change approved limits, request or end support
interaction: Separate platform health from tenant content; show support scope, approver and countdown.
guard: Operator role has no default business content access and cannot approve its own support grant.

title: Migration and exit
data: Mapping, dry run, reconciliation, cutover and exit manifest
actions: Run trial, inspect semantic diff, confirm cutover, export, close
interaction: Compare values, periods, approvals and lineage; preserve a rollback or repair path.
guard: Exit cannot skip holds; migration never fabricates historic human approval.

title: Budget workspace
data: Funding, budget versions, transactions, exchange rates and allocations
actions: Import transactions, revise budget, apply rate, allocate, review
interaction: Show source currency and reporting currency separately; reconcile allocation total and rounding residual.
guard: No silent overwrite of expenditure; reversals link the original and finance authority remains separate.
